name: Go / Gorilla / Websockets / Vue3
description: Realtime web stack: Go net/http backend with gorilla/websocket v1.5.3 and a HAND-WRITTEN hub (register/unregister/broadcast, per-client buffered send, slow-client drop policy, gorilla write deadlines, ping/pong keepalive, origin check) — the çırak-WS contrast to Stack 35's SignalR/Redis abstractions. Cookie session auth, PRD §7 envelope, bounded algorithm workbench; REST + hub verified by real Go tests and a live two-client smoke; Vue 3 + Vite SPA with a raw WebSocket live panel.
